text: {"findings":[{"type":"PRIOR_ART","title":"Repeats EXP-035 without referencing it","detail":"EXP-035 already tested live driver tracking push notifications to reduce where-is-my-order contacts. It shipped and found fatigue and opt-outs after the third push, with a learning to cap pushes at two per order. The proposal does not reference this or say how it differs, and it has no push cap.","evidence_quote":"Send live tracking push notifications when the driver is five minutes away.","citations":["experiment-registry#exp-035-live-tracking-nudges"],"recommendation":"Reference EXP-035, explain what is new, and build in its learning, such as a cap of two pushes per order. Add opt-out monitoring."},{"type":"UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM","title":"Unsourced 35% contact reduction claim","detail":"The 35% reduction is stated as fact with no source. It also conflicts with the proposal's own target (8.4 to 7.0 per 100, about 17%) and with the prior result of -7% in EXP-035.","evidence_quote":"This will cut where-is-my-order contacts by 35%.","citations":["experiment-registry#exp-035-live-tracking-nudges"],"recommendation":"Cite the source for the 35% figure or remove it. Align the claim with the stated target and the EXP-035 evidence."}]}
